name: midi_tracks
description: Ordinary C++ MIDI variable-length decoding and track reset compiled with a synthetic caller to establish their observed register arguments. Only the two complete functions are selected as game code.

functions.name: ReadMidiVariableLength
functions.actual_abi: pointer to cursor in ESI; result in EAX; plain RET

functions.name: MidiSequencer_ResetTracks
functions.actual_abi: this in EDI; plain RET; EAX naturally retains the end-track pointer, unused by callers

context.description: Synthetic repeated reset/decode caller used only for internal register allocation; not recovered game code.
